originals.role: Released header, authorship, fixed header fields, and vector comments.
The diagnostic-ROM signature for the original Macintosh processor family.

changes.change: Restored the Mac Plus header values and the earlier branch vectors. Retained the released source header and comments that describe the same fixed fields.
changes.evidence: The ROM stores an absolute reset pointer at offset four, version bytes $00 and $75, and word-displacement branches at offsets $0A, $0E, $12, $16, and $2A. The released source uses several of those positions for later ROM fields.

changes.change: Used the recorded postlink checksum for this partial build.
changes.evidence: The sum of all ROM words after the stored checksum is $4D1F8172. StartInit.a states that HiRam replaces its initial trap-count value with the checksum. A complete image build must compute this value from the assembled image.

changes.change: Restored the test loop, diagnostic-ROM check, and phase-read helper from the ROM instructions. The older bodies were not found in the released source.
changes.evidence: The reset branch enters the diagnostic-ROM check at $400042. The helper loads a signature and entry address from DiagROM, compares the signature with TROMCode, and supplies StartBoot in A1 before jumping through A0. DoPhaseRead reads three words from PhaseRead and returns through A5.

changes.change: Retained the resource-map offset $176F8 and the two zero longwords at offsets $22 and $26.
changes.evidence: The map module independently reconstructs the resource data header at $4176F8. The later source uses the two zero fields for dispatch-table and critical-error entries; this ROM does not.

verification.method: The shared verifier assembled and linked the prefix, then compared every emitted byte and all 17 labels.
limits: The prefix ends at StartBoot. The startup body and referenced test routines remain outside this module.
The comparison does not execute startup or establish the missing historical source text.
The checksum is recorded metadata until the complete ROM can be assembled and postlinked.
